avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces UGT1A1 and may reduce bictegravir plasma concentrations, potentially leading to treatment failure
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on alternative mood support options

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong UGT1A1 inducer that significantly reduces bictegravir exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative anti-tuberculous agents if needed

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (>1200 mg daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate bictegravir and reduce absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2 hours; preferably take bictegravir first

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours; monitor viral load if concurrent use necessary

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase bictegravir absorption; food effect is generally minimal but variable
caution_foods.action: Take with or without food; maintain consistent administration pattern for optimal exposure

monitoring_notes: Bictegravir has minimal drug interactions due to low hepatic metabolism and primarily renal/glucuronidation clearance. Monitor viral load and CD4 count regularly, especially if supplements affecting UGT1A1 are used; counsel patients to disclose all OTC and herbal products.
